subject: PHYSICS
pageTitle: Projectile Motion: Range, Time of Flight and Max Height
description: Break launch velocity into components and find time of flight, range and maximum height for a projectile, with two worked physics examples.
caption: Projectile motion in 7 swipes: split the velocity, then use time, range and height. Save this for your physics test. Free Physics study guide at precisstudy.com/physics (no sign-up).

slides.title: SPLIT THE LAUNCH VELOCITY
lines: v_y = v sin θ (changes by g)
slides.note: Horizontal and vertical motion are independent.

slides.title: KEY FORMULAS (g = 9.8 m/s²)
lines: Time of flight = 2 v sin θ / g
slides.note: These assume launch and landing at the same height.

slides.title: EXAMPLE 1
slides.problem: A ball is launched at 20 m/s at 30°. Find the time in the air.

slides.title: EXAMPLE 2
slides.problem: For the same launch, find the maximum height.

slides.title: WATCH OUT
slides.wrong: Vertical speed is zero the whole flight
points: Only at the top of the path is vertical velocity zero.
Horizontal velocity stays constant (no air resistance).
Use sin for vertical and cos for horizontal.
